_comment: Transformation notes for the export direction, StateU LIF -> Northgate Ed-Fi v5, keyed by rule Name (the target path). Applied by scripts/generate-crosswalk-draft.py --notes. The identity rules (StudentUniqueId, the paired StudentIdentificationCode) carry their notes in northgate-edfi-export-rules.json; this file covers the remaining rules whose behavior a reader would otherwise have to work out from the JSONata; plain field copies from the reference file keep the generated 'seeded from authored rule' marker. Facts about Ed-Fi elements refer to the Ed-Fi Data Standard v5 Unified Data Model. Only rules whose target exists in the published Northgate Ed-Fi v5 model are listed; the crosswalk report's notesUnmatched must stay empty.
Address.StateAbbreviation: REVIEW. LIF addressState holds the full state name (Georgia) while Ed-Fi StateAbbreviationDescriptor expects the two-letter code (GA). No lookup is applied in this direction; the inbound Ed-Fi -> LIF rule has the EDUcore-derived expansion, its inverse is not yet folded in.
Address.Period: REVIEW. Two LIF dates (dateEffective, dateExpired) feed the Ed-Fi Period complex element, but the expression writes only dateEffective as a scalar. Should build { BeginDate, EndDate }. Inherited from the reference rules.
